Scene 02

FLASHBACK

Dana Scully

Mulder was dying... It's all right here. For a year he was going to doctors. There's a clear record of his decline.

John Doggett (flashback)

How well did you really know him? How far would Mulder go?

Dana Scully

How far would he go for what?

John Doggett (flashback)

The truth... His truth. Whatever you and I may differ on... I'll find him, agent Scully.

Sheriff Kurt Frey

You must be special agent Doggett. I'm sheriff frey. Just call me kurt.

John Doggett

I appreciate the help, kurt.

Sheriff Kurt Frey

Shame to have you drive all the way up here on a saturday. Hate to say you're wasting your time.

John Doggett

Not if you confirm what you told me before.

Sheriff Kurt Frey

Yes, sir. Agent Mulder was here, all right... Last spring.

John Doggett

You said on the phone agent Mulder was investigating a missing woman, marie hangemuhl.

Sheriff Kurt Frey

Well, she wasn't exactly missing. He wasn't exactly investigating, either.

John Doggett

I'm not following you.

Sheriff Kurt Frey

It was a false report. Marie never even left the house. The only reason agent Mulder found out about it was because marie's sister got all excited about nothing. There. See for yourself. Say, I've got some hot coffee and a danish here if you're interested.

John Doggett

No, thanks.

Sheriff Kurt Frey

You know, if you don't mind me asking, agent Doggett what's your interest? I mean, I was actually surprised that one FBI agent gave this case a thought.

John Doggett

It's not so much the case as it is the agent. Agent Mulder disappeared last may.

Sheriff Kurt Frey

Sorry to hear that. I still don't see what that has to do with us.

John Doggett

Did agent Mulder have a personal connection here-- something that might not be in your report?

Sheriff Kurt Frey

No, I don't think he'd ever been to squamash before, as far as I know.

John Doggett

I have cell phone records showing that agent Mulder came back here the week before he disappeared.

Sheriff Kurt Frey

What for?

John Doggett

That's what I want to know. It's my job to find him.

[ knocking on door ]

Scene 03

Scene 03

Paul Hangemuhl

Kurt?

Sheriff Kurt Frey

Paul, this is agent Doggett from the FBI. He'd like to ask you and marie some questions.

Paul Hangemuhl

Marie, can you come out here a minute? This is an FBI agent. He wants to ask us a few questions. What's this all about?

John Doggett

A colleague of mine, Fox Mulder, questioned you last spring.

Paul Hangemuhl

Come on, kurt. This again? Look, this was a personal matter that's been blown way out of proportion.

Sheriff Kurt Frey

He's not investigating you, paul. He's investigating agent Mulder.

John Doggett

If you could tell me what you and agent Mulder talked about.

Fox Mulder

You told your sister you were going to disappear, mrs. Hangemuhl. Tonight.

Paul Hangemuhl

I told you already. We had a fight, she was going to leave, not disappear.

Fox Mulder

I'm talking to your wife. Mrs. Hangemuhl.

Marie Hangemuhl

It's what he said. My sister lives out of state. I was going to go... I didn't want her to worry.

Fox Mulder

You told your sister a story, a story you were afraid of?

Paul Hangemuhl

This is crazy. There is no crime here!

Fox Mulder

I don't think you were going anywhere tonight mrs. Hangemuhl. I think someone or something was coming here. And I think maybe it still is.

Paul Hangemuhl

We had a fight. We patched things up and that was the end of it.

John Doggett

The sheriff's report says that agent Mulder spoke to you on saturday, may 6th.

Marie Hangemuhl

Yeah, I-I guess so.

John Doggett

Did you see agent Mulder again that night?

Paul Hangemuhl

No, he never came back.

John Doggett

According to his cell phone records, he did. To this area, anyway. What's that there? Is that a dialysis machine?

Paul Hangemuhl

My wife suffers from end-stage renal failure. She's a very sick woman. Anything else?

John Doggett

One thing. This someone or something agent Mulder said might be coming?

Marie Hangemuhl

I just told my sister I was afraid of the stories. That's all, I didn't mean...

Paul Hangemuhl

Let me ask you something, agent Doggett. Was this Mulder guy sick? Sick in the head, I mean? Is that why you're checking into this?

John Doggett

What stories, mr. Hangemuhl?

Paul Hangemuhl

An indian folk legend about a creature who lives out in the woods. I've heard these stories since I was a kid. So your colleague twisted it into a theory that she was going to disappear, all right 'cause this creature was coming to eat her.

John Doggett

Eat her?

Paul Hangemuhl

Alive.

Sheriff Kurt Frey

Like I said, agent Doggett I hate to waste your saturday.

John Doggett

The hangemuhls own a gun, kurt?

Sheriff Kurt Frey

No, I don't think so. Why?

John Doggett

I saw three holes plastered over in their living room wall.

Sheriff Kurt Frey

Gunshots?

John Doggett

Possibly.

Sheriff Kurt Frey

You want to go back and ask 'em?

John Doggett

No.

Scene 06

FIREARMS TOOLMARK UNIT

John Doggett

Were you aware Mulder carried a second weapon, a walther ppk?

Walter Skinner

Yeah, in an ankle holster.

John Doggett

I found it hidden under his sink. The clip was three rounds shy.

Walter Skinner

What's this about?

John Doggett

Three shots were fired in a house where Mulder investigated a case last may. He never filed a report on the case or the discharge of his weapon. Do you know any reason why?

Walter Skinner

If Mulder did these things, he would've reported them.

John Doggett

Mulder submitted case reports, all right but they indicate he was here in Washington on days his cell phone records prove he was in pennsylvania.

Walter Skinner

Are you calling Mulder a liar?

John Doggett

This is the muzzle of Mulder's pistol. You see that there?

Walter Skinner

It's blowback.

John Doggett

Macrospatter of dried blood in a semi-circular pattern. Which indicates Mulder fired close-range at something or someone.

Walter Skinner

I've heard enough.

John Doggett

Where are you going?

Walter Skinner

It's where you're going, agent Doggett. You're trying to build a case that what? Mulder killed a man and then made himself disappear? That's not what happened. I told you before, he was abducted. I saw it!

John Doggett

Agent Mulder signed falsified case reports.

Walter Skinner

Oh, come on, john, this isn't about Mulder, it's about you! Your career. You give the FBI a narrative for Mulder's disappearance, you're off the X-Files and back on the fast-track to the directorship.

John Doggett

I'm just trying to find the truth.

Walter Skinner

You want the truth? Ask agent Scully!

John Doggett

I can't do that.

Walter Skinner

Why not?

John Doggett

Because she... She signed those case reports, too.

Walter Skinner

You take that story to opr the accusation alone could cost Scully her job.

John Doggett

I'm not taking it to opr. I'm taking it to you.

[ barking ]

Scene 08

SQUAMASH SHERIFF'S STATION

John Doggett

Sheriff frey.

Sheriff Kurt Frey

Back again?

John Doggett

This is assistant director Skinner. We drove up when we couldn't reach you on the phone.

Sheriff Kurt Frey

Yeah, sorry about that. I went hunting and turned off my radio. So. You find something?

John Doggett

You might say that.

Walter Skinner

You filed this death certificate at the county seat, sheriff. We're hoping you might be able to tell us something about it.

Sheriff Kurt Frey

Yeah. Yeah, last spring. An unidentified transient. Local woman found the body in the woods.

Walter Skinner

You got no suspects? No motive?

Sheriff Kurt Frey

No, why?

John Doggett

You get a lot of shootings around here? That why you failed to mention this one, kurt?

Sheriff Kurt Frey

What are you insinuating?

John Doggett

The body was found dumped outside this woman's cabin on sunday, may 7-- the morning after Mulder saw the hangemuhls.

Sheriff Kurt Frey

Okay, so I didn't make the connection. So what?

John Doggett

Three rounds were missing from Mulder's weapon.

Sheriff Kurt Frey

So Mulder came back to town to kill this man and now the hangemuhls are lying about it. Maybe I am, too.

John Doggett

Pretty much.

Sheriff Kurt Frey

This theory is even nuttier than the one agent Mulder came to town with. Where's the evidence?

John Doggett

Where's the body buried?

Scene 09

Scene 09

Walter Skinner

You're on pretty shaky ground here, agent Doggett.

John Doggett

Something happened here that night.

Walter Skinner

But you're forgetting one thing-- Fox Mulder wouldn't do this.

John Doggett

Look, somebody shot this man. Somebody fired Mulder's weapon and Mulder was here that night.

Walter Skinner

And you trying to prove that Mulder's a murderer is going to help you find him?

John Doggett

Maybe he's not. I'm not saying that he did this. Not yet. But he was here for a reason and then he disappeared.

Walter Skinner

Why would these people, people he'd never met before try to cover it up?

John Doggett

That's the question, yeah.

Walter Skinner

Earth is fresh.

John Doggett

Sheriff must've dug it up this afternoon after I left.

Walter Skinner

What would he want with the body?

John Doggett

I don't know that he found it. Looks like there's another way out.

Walter Skinner

Are you telling me the man inside that casket did this?

John Doggett

Looks pretty deep. A man doesn't get shot three times and then tunnel out of his own grave.

Walter Skinner

The sheriff said this transient was unidentified, right?

John Doggett

That's right.

Walter Skinner

Then why'd somebody leave these on top of his grave?

[ car approaching ]

[ car door opening ]

Agent Doggett.

Scene 14

Scene 14

John Fitzgerald Byers

We learned what we could. This is somewhat short notice, of course.

Melvin Frohike

And a little outside our area of expertise.

Richard Langly

Plus the fact we were sleeping.

John Doggett

You wearing pants, langly?

Richard Langly

Uh...yeah.

Walter Skinner

We don't have much time. What did you find?

Melvin Frohike

Thought you'd never ask, big guy.

John Fitzgerald Byers

The pattern you described to us is most likely a medicine wheel. It's a symbol for healing usually associated with north american shaman.

Melvin Frohike

Now, the circle represents the continuum between life and death. The journey is separated by two roads one for happiness one for sorrow.

John Fitzgerald Byers

Lakota indians teach that all these elements-- life, death, sorrow, happiness-- are all one. But it takes an enlightened mind to see it.

John Doggett

Why paint it on a door, or mark it on a grave?

Richard Langly

Well-- that's the part that takes some conjecture there, agent dogbird.

John Fitzgerald Byers

We don't know what Mulder was doing out there.

Melvin Frohike

But legends date back hundreds of years of a sin-catcher shaman also known as a soul eater.

John Doggett

A soul eater?

Richard Langly

They minister to the sick-- legend has it they consume their illnesses.

John Fitzgerald Byers

The symbol might be placed on a grave as a sign of respect. Or on a door as a summons.

Walter Skinner

A summons for what?

John Fitzgerald Byers

To indicate a sick person lives there someone in need of the creature's healing gift.

John Doggett

Thanks for your help, boys.

Richard Langly

Yeah, you're welcome.

John Doggett

Marie hangemuhl suffered from a kidney disease.

Walter Skinner

Agent Doggett?

John Doggett

That wasn't a transient buried in that grave.

Scene 15

Scene 15

John Doggett

Sorry to disturb you at this hour, ma'am. I'm agent Doggett with the FBI. May I come in? The sheriff's report last may said you found a body in the woods out here. Look, the people of this town are keeping a secret about that body-- about who it is. There was an FBI agent who came here because he believed that it was some kind of a "soul eater."

Woman

Maybe it is.

John Doggett

You believe it, too. You put those stones on top of his grave.

Woman

The things you're asking about-- they've been this way for hundreds of years. You can't change them.

John Doggett

A colleague of mine came here to try and kill this thing last spring. I believe he was trying to protect a woman named marie hangemuhl. I need your help.

Woman

You've got it all backward.

[ thumping ]

John Doggett

I'm going to get you out of here.

Scene 16

Scene 16

Walter Skinner

Agent Doggett. How is she?

John Doggett

She feels fine, you believe that? The doctor says mrs. Hangemuhl's kidneys have spontaneously healed. She's a healthy woman. Explain that.

Walter Skinner

You're going to have to explain it. The sheriff's waiting to take your statement.

John Doggett

The sheriff knows. He's known all along. So's her husband.

Walter Skinner

Known what?

John Doggett

That this soul eater took her to cure her. I thought Mulder shot this man to protect marie hangemuhl. But it wasn't her he was trying to protect.

Walter Skinner

Where are you going?

John Doggett

Something happened here. It just wasn't what we thought.

Scene 17

Scene 17

Woman

To understand what this thing is you have to understand what it can do-- its gift. People hate it because they need it. It looks the way it does because of their sickness.

John Doggett

You care for this man.

Woman

Someone always has.

John Doggett

Because you believe it? That it can cure people's sickness?

Woman

Not cure. Consume.

John Doggett

Mulder came to see you last year. Not to save marie hangemuhl. To save himself. Mulder was dying, but he kept it a secret. He had an undiagnosed brain disease. He was a sick man, desperate to find a cure.

Woman

They all are.

[ gasping ]

John Doggett

Mulder didn't do it.

Woman

Agent Mulder saw how it suffered. He saw it in its eyes. I knew what needed to be done. I just couldn't bring myself to do it.

John Doggett

Mulder killed it.

Woman

He couldn't bear to add to its pain.

John Doggett

So he came back here that night to take its pain away.

Woman

They buried it. It wanted to die. It still does, but it can't. All these months I've kept it here in secret. But now that they know it's back it'll keep suffering.

[ whimpering softly ]

Sheriff, as a federal officer I'm asking you and your men to get out of my way.

Sheriff Kurt Frey

You can't take it, agent Doggett. It belongs to us.

John Doggett

This is a man. He doesn't belong to anybody.

Sheriff Kurt Frey

We have sick people. Sick people who need what it has. We're taking it. You're free to go.

John Doggett

No, sir. I'm driving this man out of here.

[ gunshot ]

[ woman screams ]

Man

Sheriff.

Sheriff Kurt Frey

Scene 20

A.d. Skinner, you're here late.

So are you.

John Doggett

I wanted to finish my case report before agent Scully comes in tomorrow morning.

John Doggett

I don't even know where to begin or how to explain it. Only thing I do know is is I'm no closer to finding Mulder now than when I started this thing.

The truth.
